'''Watchman''' was a title used by [[Police officer/Legends|colonial law enforcement officers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. [[Whitley]] was a Watchman who oversaw law enforcement in [[Southview Village]].
